description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI class which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing reporting method configurations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting reporting methods, as well as validation rules for these operations. The class extends a generic EndPoint and implements CRUD functionality specific to reporting methods used in the HR system.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoints for CRUD operations related to reporting method configurations within the HRM system, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single reporting method configuration by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for fetching a single reporting method by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all reporting methods with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing reporting methods, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new reporting method configuration.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Handles the logic for creating or updating a ReportingMethod entity based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a reporting method, primarily validating the 'name' field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing reporting method configuration by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a reporting method, including ID and name.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForSaveReportingMethod
methods.description: Validation rules for saving a reporting method, used internally for create or update.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting reporting methods, ensuring they are not in use.
